_readme: Fifth read for the Cerritos Ironworker ladder (S330). Read 4 (run 37241442265) submitted the Schedule+ form for AED and IWAP and got 'No classes matched your criteria.' Its log shows why it may have: the form's only submit buttons are ViewDepartments (twice) and ViewDivisions, the plan's button pattern matched none, and the form went with no submitter; the Start Months boxes checked by default are August to November, Fall's. This read submits once per term with the ViewDepartments button named: Fall 2026 with the page's months, Spring 2027 with the months cleared. Read 4 also found statewidepathways.org parked for sale and the catalog's EPP page stating the route (Credit by Exam, residency waived); this read takes Cerritos's HS Credit By Exam form and AP 4050 (articulation), both found by web search 2026-10-04.
